title: Cosmetic shop (data/cosmetics.yaml)
description: T5.7: the premium currency, the packs sold for real money and the cosmetics bought with the currency. Looks only: nothing here changes stats, speed, experience, loot, capacity or timings (docs/02-game-design.md, "Tienda cosmética"). Texts: premium.* (currency), cosmetic_pack.<id>.name and cosmetic.<id>.name / .desc, in i18n/<lang>/cosmetics.yaml.

limits.description: Bounds of the shop. No pack amount may exceed daily_premium (checked by the validator).

daily_premium.description: Most premium currency one account may buy with money in any 24 hours (a checkout over it is refused before paying).

equip_burst.description: Equip anti-flood: changes allowed at once.

equip_refill_ms.description: Equip anti-flood: one more change every this many milliseconds.

packs.description: Premium currency packs sold through the payment provider's hosted checkout.

amount.description: Premium currency credited when the payment is confirmed.

price.description: Real-money price as an integer in the currency's minor unit (ISO 4217 exponent): CLP has none, so 1990 = $1.990 CLP (Mercado Pago unit_price); USD 499 = $4.99.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the real currency.

kind.description: Same values as the cosmetics.kind CHECK of migration 00004 ('mount' is reserved and not sold yet).

outfit.description: kind outfit: id of the look in data/outfits.yaml (its sprite folder and frames).

tint.description: kind outfit_color: multiply tint applied to the player's outfit.

style.description: kind name_effect: how the client draws the name label (client/src/render/cosmetics.ts).
